seoDescription: Petrina Salema's practice, based in Vienna. Homes and hospitality spaces, a few projects a year, in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.
hook: Spaces that feel considered rather than styled. Clear in plan, grounded in material, built to hold up once you live in them.
body: I started this practice in Vienna in 2021, after years studying interior design and working in architecture studios. A few homes and hospitality spaces a year, in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.

principles.title: Use over spectacle
principles.body: The work is tested in real rooms: daily life, how people move through the space, and what still feels right long after the photographs.

principles.title: A few projects a year
principles.body: There is only room for a few at a time. That pace is how the work stays careful, and how each project gets the attention it needs.

principles.title: Home and hospitality
principles.body: Whether you live there or guests do, the aim is the same: rooms for rest, gathering, and thinking.

extensions.label: Jubili
extensions.note: Hospitality design brand co-founded from this practice
